question: The mean and the mode of a data set are 33.9 and 40.1, respectively. Find the median of the data, using the empirical formula. (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **Empirical Formula**: 3 × **Median** = **Mode** + 2 × **Mean**.

3 × **Median** = 40.1 + 2 × 33.9

3 × **Median** = 40.1 + 67.8 = 107.9

**Median** = 107.9 ÷ 3 = 35.966...

Rounding to two decimal places, we get 35.97.

**∴ The correct answer is 35.97.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Mean** = 33.9

**Mode** = 40.1

**Formula Used:**

**Mode** = 3(**Median**) − 2(**Mean**)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72182fbfe79f7b38561ac77b7e670c541cbe31f7e6f8d204215b9291b59f286b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 40.1 = 3 × **Median** − 2 × 33.9

⇒ 40.1 = 3 × **Median** − 67.8

⇒ 3 × **Median** = 40.1 + 67.8

⇒ 3 × **Median** = 107.9

⇒ **Median** = 107.9 ÷ 3

⇒ **Median** = 35.9666...

⇒ **Median** ≈ 35.97

**∴ The correct answer is 35.97.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Symmetric Distribution

In a perfectly **Symmetric Distribution**, the values of **Mean**, **Median**, and **Mode** are all equal (Mean = Median = Mode).

Skewness Identification

If **Mode > Median > Mean**, the distribution is **Negatively Skewed** (skewed to the left). If **Mean > Median > Mode**, it is **Positively Skewed**.</p
